steps.note: Start a multi-stage project with Technical and RFQ stages.
Provide the required project title.
Create the Technical Stage and RFQ pair required by the case.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit a schedule so the project can be published.
Provide the initial participant required for publishing.
Publish the project so participants can be managed on a stage.
Confirm the project reached its published page.
Open the RFQ stage where the additional vendor will be added.
Open the RFQ Participants list.
Add another vendor through the RFQ stage's participant controls.
Assert the newly added vendor is present on the RFQ stage.
Confirm the RFQ participant list increased by exactly one vendor.
Capture the RFQ participant table for comparison with the Technical Stage.
Open the Technical Stage.
Open the Technical Stage Participants list.
Assert the Technical Stage contains the same total participants as the RFQ after the addition.
Assert the vendor added on RFQ is also present on the Technical Stage.
Compare the Technical Stage participant table with the RFQ table to verify the vendor list is shared.
